objective: Enable accurate BSOC user-admin triage and safe replies when AI provider quota is unavailable, preserve case navigation and surface privacy-safe render diagnostics.
productionBaselineEvidence: Nov 12 production logs confirmed bsoc-gpt-debug-v1 upstream 429 causing 502, Android 1.3.6 RENDER_7DA38BC7 admin/:id, and unresolved support feedback. Exact render component still needs a device stack or narrowed route.
chosenApproach: Use existing BSOC permissions/RLS, audited support status RPC, and reply notification trigger. AI failures get clearly marked non-AI fixed troubleshooting; no automatic case content export or member reply.
selectionRationale: Small isolated app and function patch, no schema/API permission broadening; source patch can be consolidated into verified RC.
alternativeApproaches: Fake provider success or silently generate AI text (rejected)
Change production OTA before runtime verification (rejected)
preserveBehaviors: Wall, Ads, videos, finance, points, public privacy and global nav routing unchanged
Member notifications only from existing backend agent message trigger
Historical case read restricted to System Admin; mutation still uses existing audited RPC
No automatic member replies, no claim of OTA/backend repair
acceptanceChecks: HTTP 429 produces clearly labelled manual guidance, not AI answer
Auth and BSOC permission checks remain server-side
The app shows safe typed diagnostic errors and links to its real case queue
Static admin routes appear in future crash reports without exposing dynamic IDs
Historical authorized case can be opened beyond the bounded 100 item queue
Each case offers an editable targeted safe reply and an explicit closure gate
Source tests plus Android RC compile and runtime/device test before release

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Constrain support changes to existing BSOC admin surfaces and safe route fingerprints
preservedBehaviors: No changes to main public screens or existing media playback
